result.title: PEAM: On-device Communication Agent for Personalized, Efficient and Autonomous Mobile Network Configuration
result.summary: The growing deployment of compact large language models on smartphones is enabling autonomous on-device decision-making, such as emerging mobile GUI agents. However, many mobile decisions, such as network configuration when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, must satisfy stringent latency constraints to preserve user experience. In this paper, we propose PEAM, an on-device LLM-based communication agent that autonomously generates personalized network-configuration rules executable within milliseconds. Specifically, PEAM first fine-tune the on-device LLM with a dataset constructed from manually annotated real-user data to integrate the communication knowledge into the local model. PEAM then operates in two phases. In the rule-generation phase, which is performed when the device is idle, such as overnight, PEAM analyzes historical network-configuration records in batches and reflects across batches to consolidate consistent evidence, reduce local bias, and derive robust configuration rules. To enable more accurate and stable rule generation over time, PEAM further constructs a user profile from high-confidence rules to capture the user's network preferences and incorporates this profile into each rule-generation cycle. In the rule-execution phase, PEAM is invoked when the communication context changes, such as when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, and searches the rule library to identify and execute the appropriate rule. Experiments demonstrate that PEAM, based on a fine-tuned 4B model, achieves 99.13% correct network configuration decisions, while 92.50% of the rules generated by PEAM are valid, outperforming the traditional expert-rule based method by 4.41% and 84.50%, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: PEAM 是一个端侧 LLM 通信智能体，通过微调本地模型并在空闲时分批分析历史网络配置记录、跨批次反思生成个性化规则，在通信上下文变化时检索并毫秒级执行规则。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文处理的是手机网络配置规则生成与执行，属端侧 LLM 应用与延迟优化，不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态、视觉证据筛选或 latent 推理，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
